headline: Your BnBerry waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing independent hotels and resorts into the right BnBerry Airbnb/Vrbo connectivity, guest-messaging, and 3D-tour offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Fiona Taylor.
productSummary: BnBerry is a hotel/resort channel-management and full-service platform that connects properties to Airbnb, Vrbo, and similar lodging marketplaces. Core offers on bnberry.com: (1) Airbnb & Vrbo Connection and Management — the only channel-management solution they position as designed for hotels to connect to Airbnb, Vrbo, and more, with optimized listings, 24/7 guest support, and analytics; (2) Guest Messaging — text messaging for hotels to stay connected with guests, generate 5-star reviews, and grow online bookings without hiring; (3) 3D / 360 virtual tours vs static photos to lift engagement and bookings. Homepage value props: reach new markets, expand sales, enhance guest satisfaction; easy integration into the existing hotel stack (DerbySoft, SynXis, Sabre, SiteMinder, and more). Connectivity page production stats: 7500+ room nights / year, 4-night avg length of stay, 4 guests per booking, 40-day avg booking window; image claim Boost Your Revenue by 30% annually. Airbnb/Vrbo communication traffic is 10x higher vs other OTAs (connectivity page). DIY portal: listing management, guest communications, analytics. DerbySoft partnership (Jul 2024) lists 5.5% commission on produced bookings, $150/mo minimum, $1,000 assisted onboarding for 1–3 hotel portfolios; enterprise for 4+. Founded 2016 (Dealroom: Ilya Sosnin); HQ Miami Beach; LinkedIn ~48 employees. Named homepage customers: Forest Suites Resort (Alesha Newman), AD1 Global (Rene Pereira), Plantation on Crystal River (Laurie Pike), Terrapin Hospitality (Alex Cerda).
coreInsight: Fiona already sells hotel-native Airbnb/Vrbo distribution, guest messaging, and 3D tours so properties stop leaving marketplace demand and guest-reply SLAs on the table. The one list is independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups that sell rooms (BnBerry's buyer), not STR hosts. The one routing signal is marketplace_stack_state: how the property already shows up on Booking.com/Expedia vs Airbnb/Vrbo, plus which channel manager sits on the stack, because Booking/Expedia scrapes, Airbnb/Vrbo listing search, and BuiltWith / CM detections (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Guesty, Hostaway, and peers) return that state in one pull. Review-reply latency on live marketplace listings is the next rung. Title (GM / DOS / Revenue) is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall.

sampleValues.{{airbnb_surface}}: no Airbnb or Vrbo listing found
sampleValues.{{review_gap}}: Airbnb inquiries sitting unanswered past 1 hour

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how the hotel already shows up on lodging marketplaces
sections.takeaway: Booking.com/Expedia presence, Airbnb/Vrbo listing presence, and a named channel manager on BuiltWith already tell you whether the new-channel offer, the full-service switch, or guest messaging should lead. That stack-state is stronger than a title guess, and it is cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM hotel and resort
sections.takeaway: First match wins. On Booking/Expedia but missing Airbnb/Vrbo goes first, then Airbnb/Vrbo listings sitting on a competitor CM, then live marketplace listings with weak guest-reply / review response, then every remaining independent hotel or small resort group.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each marketplace state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Missing Airbnb/Vrbo gets a New Channel Brief. Competitor-CM Airbnb/Vrbo listings get a Full-Service Switch Brief. Weak guest-reply listings get a Guest Messaging Brief. The rest get the 3D Tour / Extra Distribution Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Open Airbnb/Vrbo, upgrade full-service, fix guest reply, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always in-TAM independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups that sell rooms, aimed at Directors of Sales, GMs, Revenue Managers, and Owners. Brand vs independent is a merge tag, not a second TAM. A/Bs sit on the exclusive routes.

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the marketplace state already on their stack
sections.takeaway: Notice the OTA gap, the competitor CM, or the slow guest reply, poke the revenue or review pain that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the missing-Airbnb/Vrbo route first
sections.takeaway: Start where the property already sells rooms on Booking/Expedia but has no Airbnb/Vrbo listing. Prove reply density, then roll competitor-CM switches, guest-messaging, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo plus LinkedIn plus hotel/resort directories (and Booking.com / Expedia property lists) are the TAM Fiona already sells into: independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups that sell rooms — est. 20k+ accounts (TAM size is a flagged estimate; not published as a count on bnberry.com).

The same Booking/Expedia scrape + Airbnb/Vrbo listing search + BuiltWith / CM detection returns marketplace_stack_state: on traditional OTAs but missing Airbnb/Vrbo, live Airbnb/Vrbo with a named CM (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Guesty, Hostaway, and peers), or a live listing with slow guest-reply / review response — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live BnBerry positioning on bnberry.com: hotel-native Airbnb & Vrbo Connection and Management, Guest Messaging without hiring, and 3D/360 tours vs static photos, plus stack integrations they name (DerbySoft, SynXis, Sabre, SiteMinder).
Buyer title and property brand labels are scrape filters and merge tags. They are not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the domain is routed, never the TAM spine alone.

sources.name: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Navigator company graph
sources.delivers: In-TAM independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups plus Director of Sales / GM / Revenue Manager / Owner titles. The TAM gate.

sources.name: Booking.com / Expedia property scrape
sources.delivers: ota_surface used to prove traditional OTA presence for Tier 1. Confirms the hotel already sells rooms online.

sources.name: Airbnb / Vrbo listing search scrape
sources.delivers: airbnb_vrbo_state used across Tiers 1–3: listing present or absent, plus a proxy for review volume and reply latency on live listings.

sources.name: BuiltWith / script and channel-manager detection
sources.delivers: Named competitor or adjacent CM detections (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Guesty, Hostaway, and peers) used to assign Tier 2. One pull. Note: bnberry.com also lists SiteMinder as an integration partner — treat detection as stack-state, not as a blanket 'rip and replace' claim.

sources.name: Optional hotel / resort directories and Google Maps lodging categories
sources.delivers: Backup in_tam when LinkedIn industry tags are messy. Gate only.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw 'hotel manager' list and hope.

sources.name: Optional BnBerry customer suppress
sources.delivers: Current-customer exclusion when the signal is visible. Thin coverage. Treat as a suppress list, not a tier. Named homepage testimonials (Forest Suites, AD1 Global, Plantation on Crystal River, Terrapin Hospitality) are not a franchise-wide exclude.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND ota_surface = on_booking_or_expedia AND airbnb_vrbo_state = not_listed
routingRules.why: They already sell rooms on traditional OTAs but are missing the Airbnb/Vrbo traveler. Strongest intent for BnBerry's core offer: Connect your Hotel to Airbnb and Vrbo and see immediate ROI; Forest Suites quote on homepage about Airbnb as a growing segment as STR legislation cuts inventory.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND airbnb_vrbo_state = listed AND competitor_cm detected (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Guesty, Hostaway, or another named CM / Airbnb connector)
routingRules.why: Inventory is already on Airbnb/Vrbo through a generic CM or DIY connector. Pain is hotel-native listing optimization + 24/7 marketplace guest support (connectivity page: Airbnb/Vrbo traffic is 10x other OTAs). BnBerry's full-service / DIY portal is the upgrade, not a lecture about what Airbnb is.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND airbnb_vrbo_state = listed AND no Tier-2 competitor_cm AND review_gap = weak_or_slow_reply (slow Airbnb/Vrbo guest reply or weak review response visible on the listing)
routingRules.why: The listing is live but guest-comms are the leak. Homepage Guest Messaging pitch: stay connected, generate 5-star reviews, grow bookings without hiring; resolve issues by text. Maps to the SMS / review offer, not a new-channel sell.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups). Softest CTA around 3D/360 tours and broader marketplace distribution. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: On Booking/Expedia, missing Airbnb/Vrbo
tiers.trigger: Property is live on Booking.com and/or Expedia, and Airbnb/Vrbo listing search returns no matching hotel listing
tiers.pain: They already pay to distribute rooms on traditional OTAs but are invisible to Airbnb/Vrbo travelers. Homepage customers (Forest Suites, AD1 Global) frame new booking channels as critical as STR inventory tightens.
tiers.valueProp: BnBerry's Airbnb & Vrbo Connection and Management: hotel-native channel manager, optimized listings, 24/7 guest support, analytics. Connectivity page: 7500+ room nights / year, 4-night avg LOS, 4 guests per booking, 40-day avg booking window; Boost Your Revenue by 30% annually (on-site image). Start seeing new revenues in as little as a few weeks.
tiers.dataSource: Booking.com / Expedia scrape + Airbnb/Vrbo listing search
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already sell rooms online and are missing the channel BnBerry opens
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on bnberry.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Airbnb/Vrbo live on a competitor CM
tiers.trigger: Airbnb and/or Vrbo listing is live AND BuiltWith / stack scan shows SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Guesty, Hostaway, or another named CM / Airbnb connector
tiers.pain: Marketplace inventory is live, but a generic CM connector does not give hotel-native listing optimization or the 24/7 Airbnb/Vrbo guest-support load. Connectivity page: Airbnb/Vrbo communication traffic is 10x higher vs other OTAs and needs a dedicated team.
tiers.valueProp: Full-service or DIY portal: optimized listings, Instant Guest Support 24/7, analytics, and payments handled. Integrations with DerbySoft, SynXis, Sabre, SiteMinder so the team does not jump through hoops. Pitch is production lift + guest-support coverage on top of (or instead of) a thin CM connector.
tiers.dataSource: Airbnb/Vrbo listing scrape + BuiltWith / CM detection
tiers.replyDensity: High - they already wired Airbnb/Vrbo and still feel the ops and production gap

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Airbnb/Vrbo live, weak guest-reply / reviews
tiers.trigger: Airbnb/Vrbo listing is live, no Tier-2 competitor_cm match, and listing shows slow guest reply or weak review response
tiers.pain: The listing is live but guest messaging and review response are leaking conversion and star rating. Airbnb/Vrbo guests expect fast replies; hotels are not staffed for that channel.
tiers.valueProp: Guest Messaging on bnberry.com: text messaging for hotels to stay connected, generate 5-star reviews, and grow online bookings without hiring. Resolve guest issues by text. Same 24/7 support muscle BnBerry already runs for marketplace traffic.
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - visible reply/review gap, urgency varies by season

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM hotels / resorts
tiers.trigger: In-TAM independent hotel or small hotel/resort group with a sales / GM / revenue decision maker and no Tier 1-3 marketplace_stack_state
tiers.pain: Marketplace demand and listing conversion still depend on distribution breadth and how the property is shown online, and there is no BnBerry layer yet.
tiers.valueProp: 3D/360 tours vs static photos plus optional Airbnb/Vrbo distribution. Homepage: reach new markets, maximize sales, elevate guest experience without complex integrations. Soft CTA into the tour / extra-distribution playbook.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo + LinkedIn company + title graph after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM

campaigns.name: Missing Airbnb/Vrbo while live on Booking/Expedia
campaigns.strategy: Lead with {{ota_surface}} present and {{airbnb_surface}} missing, then offer a one-page New Channel Brief: hotel-native Airbnb/Vrbo connect, 7500+ room nights / year, 30% annual revenue boost claim from bnberry.com connectivity creative.
campaigns.value: New marketplace revenue without a complex stack rebuild

campaigns.name: Airbnb/Vrbo live on competitor CM
campaigns.strategy: Name {{competitor_cm}} on the stack next to a live Airbnb/Vrbo listing, poke the 10x guest-comms load and thin listing optimization, offer the Full-Service Switch Brief (24/7 support + optimized listings + analytics).
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. Keep copy about production and guest support, not Airbnb 101. Note SiteMinder is also named as a BnBerry integration — frame as upgrade/coverage, not a hostile rip.

campaigns.name: Airbnb/Vrbo live, weak guest reply / reviews
campaigns.filter: in_tam + airbnb_vrbo_listed + review_gap + no Tier-2 CM
campaigns.strategy: Lead with {{review_gap}} on the live listing, then Guest Messaging: text guests, protect 5-star reviews, no new hires.
campaigns.value: Guest reply and review recovery without hiring
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. {{buyer_title}} is a merge tag.

campaigns.name: Remaining independent hotels / resorts
campaigns.strategy: Soft 3D Tour / Extra Distribution Playbook. Property type and title as merge tags. Soft CTA.
campaigns.value: Simple path to 3D tours and extra marketplace distribution

launchPlan: Confirm in_tam definition: independent hotels and small hotel/resort groups that sell rooms (BnBerry ICP on bnberry.com). Pure STR hosts / Airbnb-only homeowners are out of TAM.

Pull Apollo / Sales Nav for those companies, then Booking.com/Expedia scrape + Airbnb/Vrbo listing search + BuiltWith / CM detection for marketplace_stack_state. Suppress known BnBerry customers when visible. Named testimonials are not a blanket exclude.

Launch Tier 1 only until reply density is clear (target ~1 positive / 150-300). Do not launch a tier under ~1,500 contacts. Per-tier account counts are flagged estimates — not published on bnberry.com.
Add Tier 2 competitor-CM Airbnb/Vrbo once Tier 1 copy is stable.
Add Tier 3 weak guest-reply / review gap, then the catch-all for remaining in-TAM accounts.
Enrich emails via Apollo only after the account is routed.
A/B New Channel Brief vs Forest Suites / AD1 proof on Tier 1 before cloning angles downward.

thresholds.action: Scale the tier and clone winning angles downward
Keep running; tighten personalization on {{ota_surface}}, {{competitor_cm}}, or {{review_gap}}
Test a subject or offer variant before cutting

thresholds.rate: <1% reply after 1,500 sends OR past 1 positive / 500
thresholds.action: Cut the tier and move volume to the next exclusive route
